title: Pre-Market Briefing - 2026-10-15
markdown:
## 1. Market Tone
- **Confirmed market backdrop:** StockAnalysis.com said all 3 main indices sank yesterday, with the S&P 500 down 1.1% and the Nasdaq down 1.9%, their worst day in over 2 months. Their pre-open snapshot showed S&P 500 -0.28%, Nasdaq -1.20%, and Dow +0.42% (Source: StockAnalysis.com).
- **Confirmed driver:** The same source said the tech rout deepened amid investor concerns over AI spending, with **CRWV**, **MU**, **NVDA**, **STX**, **AMD**, and **AVGO** down 3–4% in the prior session, while **ORCL** and **AMD** also saw notable drops (Source: StockAnalysis.com).
- **Confirmed sentiment cue:** The Motley Fool said global chip stocks were selling off as investors questioned whether the AI-driven rally had overextended, and that **NVDA**, **AVGO**, and **INTC** were down at least 1% before the open (Source: The Motley Fool).
- **Interpretation:** This looks like a risk-off, AI-sensitive tape into the open, with momentum/semis under pressure while the broad market is mixed.

## 2. Macro And Calendar
- **Confirmed macro print:** StockAnalysis.com reported U.S. wholesale inflation (PPI) came in hotter than expected at 6.3% YoY versus 5.3% expected, the highest level since 2022 (Source: StockAnalysis.com).
- **Confirmed labor data:** Initial jobless claims were 199,000 for the week ending Oct. 10, up 1,000 week over week, and the 4-week moving average was 198,500, up 250 week over week (Source: StockAnalysis.com).
- **Confirmed scheduled releases/events for today, ET:** 8:30 AM PPI MoM and Core PPI MoM; 8:30 AM Retail Sales MoM, Retail Sales Ex-Autos MoM, and Retail Sales Control Group MoM; 8:30 AM Initial Jobless Claims; 8:30 AM NY Empire State Manufacturing Index; 8:30 AM Philadelphia Fed Manufacturing Index; 10:00 AM Business Inventories MoM; 12:00 PM EIA Crude Oil & Gasoline Stocks Change; 11:30 PM Fed Chair Warsh Speech (Source: StockAnalysis.com).
- **Interpretation:** The 8:30 AM batch is the main macro catalyst window for the cash-open trade, especially given the hotter-than-expected inflation backdrop.

## 3. Earnings And Company News
- **Confirmed pre-market earnings reaction:** **TSM** reported record Q3 profit of about $23.9 billion, up 69%, with revenue above guidance and operating margin of 58.7% versus a 58% guidance range; Source 1 also said gross margin dipped slightly during its 2-nanometer ramp and that high-performance computing was 68% of revenue (Sources: StockAnalysis.com, The Motley Fool).
- **Confirmed additional TSM details:** StockAnalysis.com said **TSM** raised its 2026 revenue growth outlook to 44% and expects Q4 sales of $52.3–$54.3 billion, while remaining cautious about 2027; shares were down 2% premarket in that source (Source: StockAnalysis.com).
- **Confirmed company news:** The Motley Fool said **RKLB** fell 10% premarket after saying Neutron’s first flight slipped to 2027; it also said Rocket Lab had previously aimed for the launch pad in Q4 and that each delay pushes out the roughly $55 million per Neutron flight revenue further (Source: The Motley Fool).
- **Confirmed earnings setup for today:** The Motley Fool said **PLD** reports before the open, has met or beaten EPS estimates in each of the past four quarters, and that full-year guidance plus commentary on the SEGRO takeover are the key items to watch (Source: The Motley Fool).
- **Confirmed after-close earnings today:** The Motley Fool said **IBKR** reports after the close, with analysts expecting 67 cents per share, about 17.5% growth year over year; it added that September trading activity was up 6% year over year, shifting attention to net interest income and margin lending (Source: The Motley Fool).
- **Confirmed broader company news:** StockAnalysis.com said **AAPL** reached a $5.01T market cap at Wednesday’s close, becoming only the second company after **NVDA** to hit that milestone; it also said **AAPL** shares were at $342.96 and up 26.5% YTD in that report (Source: StockAnalysis.com).
- **Confirmed other notable headlines:** StockAnalysis.com reported **SKHY** fell 8% premarket on a report linking U.S. factory plans to White House approval for additional equipment at its Chinese facility; **BSP** surged 41% after Berkshire added another $330M stake; **TSLA** was down 1.6% premarket ahead of a planned Roadster unveiling; **GFS** rose 5% on a chip-expansion plan; **AZN** gained 2.7% premarket after a $1.86B AI drug-discovery deal; **NFLX** rose around 1% premarket after announcing about 6% workforce cuts; and **GOOGL** was tied to reports of a YouTube audiobook feature under development (Source: StockAnalysis.com).
- **Confirmed recommendation/news flow:** Stock Advisor named **AXON** its new recommendation, citing 18 consecutive quarters of revenue growth above 28% and saying the stock’s recent pullback comes despite blowout results and raised guidance (Source: Stock Advisor).
